findings.title: Remote Desktop session tools and mode switch disappear below 1280px
findings.resolution: Expose remote tools through a keyboard-accessible side panel below 1280px and restore trigger focus.

findings.title: Stickyboard duplicates stale content and leaves the editor after a failed save
findings.resolution: Require acknowledged current board contents before duplication; keep editor after failed save.

findings.title: Git inline editor silently drops unsaved edits when another preview opens
findings.resolution: Hold per-checkout/path Git editor drafts and their original revisions in memory; warn before unload and clear on sign-out.

findings.title: System Users incorrectly presents a locked password as disabled SSH access
findings.resolution: Label and count password authentication locks accurately, preserving authorized-key sign-in routes and explaining SSH/PAM policy.
findings.limits: Authorized keys are a known route; actual SSH acceptance depends on host SSH/PAM/account policy. No live account changes were exercised.

findings.title: API-key dialog retains the previous secret and cannot create the next key after Done
findings.resolution: Reset one-time API key and creation fields on every close/reopen.

findings.title: Password-only sessions falsely report password and code
findings.resolution: Record password/TOTP/recovery provenance separately from access elevation; additive legacy unknown migration.

findings.title: Add-computer flow displays endless skeleton when overview fails
findings.resolution: Show failed computer-overview load with retry in Add computer.

findings.title: Sunshine readiness is described as a live video session before video exists
findings.resolution: Distinguish backend Ready from observed video playback; clear playback after document navigation or stalled media.
findings.limits: Canvas/WebCodecs-only or inaccessible player documents have no observed HTML video playback; their honest status remains Ready.

findings.title: Remote session ignores failed computer inventory and stays blank/connecting
findings.resolution: Show remote-session inventory error and retry before connection workspace.

findings.title: Escape on Stickyboard name saves the edit it was meant to cancel
findings.resolution: Suppress rename commit on blur caused by Escape.

findings.title: Board navigation considers one flush successful even if edited snapshot has advanced
findings.resolution: Drain board saves until the latest edited snapshot is acknowledged before navigating; retain dirty conflict unload warnings.

findings.title: Suggested native-dump-only backup cannot be created
findings.resolution: Allow a filesystem source or a native database dump; verify native-only archive, coverage and native restore.

findings.title: Database backup deep link clears its input before coverage can arrive
findings.resolution: Consume database backup handoff only after resource data opens the suggested editor.

findings.title: Unpicking resource removes manually entered or shared backup inputs
findings.resolution: Track picker-owned contributions and preserve manual or shared inputs when unselecting.

findings.title: Failed backup run history is shown as no runs
findings.resolution: Expose failed run-history reads with retry or stale-data warning.

findings.title: Unavailable or invalid Docker detail tabs leave an empty detail body
findings.resolution: Normalize invalid/unavailable Docker detail views to the first available tab.

findings.title: Container detail state remains stale after changes made outside this page
findings.resolution: Poll container identity and route bindings every ten seconds and refresh after mutations while retaining child drafts.

findings.title: Images can display a green current verdict when registry checks are unknown
findings.resolution: Include matching secondary tags/digests; distinguish unknown checks from verified current status.

findings.title: Folder uploads bypass nested-name collision review
findings.resolution: Plan folder-upload collisions in each actual directory, with explicit existing-folder merge and collision policy. Preserve canonical root destinations so completion refreshes the current directory.

findings.title: Cron previews use browser timezone and can hide that disclosure
findings.resolution: Report measured host and positional CRON_TZ metadata, forecast in that zone and disclose browser date display/fallback.
findings.limits: Native daemon CRON_TZ/DST behavior varies. POSIX or unavailable zones cannot be predicted; the page discloses forecast absence or estimates.

findings.title: Native log exports are silently limited to 20,000 lines
findings.resolution: Disclose native export limits, scans, missing sources and default journal window in downloaded coverage metadata; propagate read failures.
findings.limits: Native exports remain bounded to 20,000 selected lines/five-minute scans; journal with no start date reads 48 hours unless Current boot is selected. Omitted coverage is marked PARTIAL. Completeness is relative to available retained source output; source or decoder errors are recorded as missing coverage.

findings.title: Failed package installs remain marked Started and cannot be retried from result row
findings.resolution: Track accepted package jobs independently of console, allow failed/canceled retries and refresh catalogue flags and inventory/update readings at terminal outcomes.

findings.title: Package upgrade confirmation promises constraints not applied by every manager
findings.resolution: Describe actual manager-specific dependency/replacement scope and possible service restarts.

findings.title: File/config/crontab saves do not protect against concurrent external edits
findings.resolution: Add guarded content revisions to Files/Git/Compose/crontab writes; retain conflicted drafts and serialize dashboard saves.
findings.regressions: revision_test.go; revision_shared_test.go; handlers_files_revision_test.go; compose_revision_test.go; cron_test.go; files-ui.spec.ts; git-features.spec.ts; stack-detail.spec.ts; processes-ui.spec.ts
findings.limits: Legacy API callers may omit revision. Uncoordinated native writers can race between final comparison and publication; dashboard writes are serialized.

findings.title: Editing an hourly cron job silently resets its minute to zero
findings.resolution: Open nonzero hourly minutes as Custom and retain the original schedule on command-only edits.

findings.title: Expired API session stays inside the authenticated shell without a sign-in recovery path
findings.resolution: Revalidate recognized feature authentication failures, redirect confirmed expiry to sign-in, retain identity on transient failures and fence login/logout response races. Keep a nonsensitive account owner ID through reload and clear a prior or unknown owner's working stores on sign-in.

findings.title: Allowlist helper misidentifies which CIDR covers IPv4 loopback
findings.resolution: Compute IPv4 CIDR membership for loopback instead of matching the host spelling.

findings.title: Empty merged block list can claim no engine blocks anyone despite omitted/unread data
findings.resolution: Describe empty returned merged block view without claiming complete engine enforcement.

findings.title: Saved-query URL handoff is discarded at full tab capacity
findings.resolution: Keep saved-query handoff pending at 24-tab capacity and accept it when a slot opens.

findings.title: Backup job detail reopens a retained stale edit draft
findings.resolution: Clear job editor drafts on explicit close and successful save.

findings.title: Canceling a Cut paste clears the clipboard
findings.resolution: Clear only successfully moved Cut sources; preserve canceled, skipped or failed sources.

findings.title: Cron schedule parser accepts malformed trailing syntax and can show invalid previews
findings.resolution: Reject malformed field separators/bounds/steps, preserve environment whitespace and native leading-star day semantics.

findings.title: Export crashes on a valid five-digit-year datetime input
findings.resolution: Parse extended HTML years then show RFC3339 range/order errors; disable invalid exports/search and validate server download bounds.

findings.title: Administrator filter/count omits UID 0 accounts and other root routes
findings.resolution: Include UID 0 and known sudo/wheel/admin/docker group routes; state direct sudoers rules are not inspected.
findings.limits: Direct sudoers rules and other unknown privilege routes are not parsed.
